categories.main_business_segments: Toll Brothers operates primarily in luxury residential homebuilding, offering single-family detached homes, attached homes, master-planned communities, and urban low-, mid-, and high-rise condominiums. The company also has a segment for land development and, until recently, developed and operated for-rent apartment and student housing communities through joint ventures, but is in the process of exiting the multifamily rental business. Operations are organized into five geographic segments: North, Mid-Atlantic, South, Mountain, and Pacific regions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Toll Brothers utilizes in-house architectural, engineering, and land development teams, as well as subsidiaries for mortgage, title, insurance, smart home technology, and landscaping. Home construction is managed by Toll Brothers as general contractor, with subcontractors performing most construction and land development under fixed-price contracts. The company operates manufacturing facilities for lumber distribution and house component assembly, and leverages design studios for customer customization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company targets luxury first-time, move-up, empty-nester (move-down), active-adult, and second-home buyers, primarily in affluent suburban and select urban markets across the United States. Key customer segments include affluent families, millennials, Gen Z, and active adults (including age-restricted 55+ communities), as well as buyers seeking affordable luxury homes. Historically, Toll Brothers has also served renters and students through its multifamily joint ventures.
categories.geographic_coverage: Toll Brothers operates in 24 states and the District of Columbia, with major markets including the Boston, New York, Philadelphia, Washington D.C., Atlanta, Dallas, Houston, Denver, Phoenix, Las Vegas, San Diego, Los Angeles, San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, and Florida metropolitan areas. The company’s five reporting regions are North, Mid-Atlantic, South, Mountain, and Pacific, with significant operations and revenue concentration in California.
categories.supply_chain_position: Toll Brothers is a downstream operator, acting as a developer, builder, and seller of finished homes directly to end consumers. The company controls land acquisition and development, manages home construction, and provides related services such as mortgage origination and title insurance, but outsources most construction and land development work to subcontractors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Toll Brothers focuses on expanding its product lines and price points, increasing geographic reach, and growing its inventory of quick move-in (spec) homes to compete with existing home sales. The company emphasizes design innovation, curated customer experiences, and operational efficiency, particularly in affordable luxury and spec homes. Recent strategic moves include exiting the multifamily rental business to concentrate on core homebuilding and capital efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: The primary revenue model is the sale of new homes, including both build-to-order and spec homes, with additional revenue from land sales, options and upgrades, and ancillary services such as mortgage origination, title, and insurance. The company also earns management and construction fees from joint ventures and, until recently, recognized gains from the sale of rental properties developed through joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Toll Brothers competes with large national, regional, and local homebuilders, as well as the resale home market. Key competitors include D.R. Horton, Lennar, PulteGroup, and other luxury and regional builders. The company positions itself as a leading luxury homebuilder with a strong brand, financial stability, and a reputation for quality, design, and customer service, which it believes provides a competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2025, Toll Brothers generated $10.97 billion in revenue and $1.35 billion in net income, delivering 11,292 homes. The company had $5.49 billion in backlog (4,647 homes) at year-end and controlled approximately 76,100 home sites. While revenue and home deliveries grew modestly year-over-year, net income declined due to margin pressures and lower land sale gains. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with $1.26 billion in cash and low leverage.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Toll Brothers differentiates itself through its luxury brand, high-quality construction, customizable home designs, and curated customer experiences. The company emphasizes architectural diversity, premium locations, and a wide range of structural and finishing options, appealing to affluent buyers seeking personalization and upscale amenities. Its reputation for quality, design, and service, along with financial stability, underpins its value proposition in the luxury and affordable luxury segments.
